rows.grounds: recipient of offering; dative of the goddess Kālī
that which has been presented as an offering
distributive relative pronoun indicating any and all items
a share of that offered substance

items.question: What portion of items offered to Kālī must the practitioner consume?
premises: Items may be offered to Kālī.
Any such offered item has a portion designated for the practitioner.
Ritual instruction prescribes consuming that portion.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should eat a portion of whatever has been offered to Kālī.
uncertainties: The exact size or nature of the portion (aṃśa) is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: O Śivā, whatever is offered to Kālī, one should eat a portion of that.
